api.state: Host-owned named context, saved result, variable bank, input buffer and error lifecycle. No CPU registers or frame are materialized in calculator RAM.
api.begin: PREPARED corresponds to native F2AC before evaluation; COMPLETE covers history/reset/empty gates.
api.tick: A prepared tick evaluates once, commits success or starts a wait. Waiting ticks consume semantic key/bridge events. EXPORT is nonterminal; RESET requests the host boot lifecycle.
api.finish: Consumes completion and returns native F12A action0 reset/no-op,1 editable recovery or2 result redraw.
api.present: Refreshes ordinary action1/2 input, then a result when not editing, and updates replay navigation. Does not consume completion.
